functionDeclarations.name: get_tsl_esc_eoc_state
functionDeclarations.description: Retrieves the live state of the Tsl.Esc.Eoc sovereign stablecoin, including escrow reserves, minted supply, collateral backing ratio, DAG transmittance confirmation, and daily yield revenue.

includeAllocations.description: Whether to include full yield deployment allocations across FedNow, Treasuries, and 29-exchange market making.

functionDeclarations.name: execute_shadow_trade
functionDeclarations.description: Executes a simulated delta-neutral cross-venue arbitrage trade across the 29-exchange mesh, computing latency, slippage, and fee accounting.

targetSpreadBps.description: Minimum basis points spread required between buy and sell venue.

tradeSizeUsd.description: Total size of the arbitrage order in USD.

functionDeclarations.name: dispatch_dag_transmittance
functionDeclarations.description: Transmits verified sovereign state, escrow balance proofs, or arbitrage settlement batches to the Constellation Federal DAG Hypergraph.

payloadType.description: The type of sovereign state update to transmit.

channelId.description: The target DAG State Channel (defaults to DAG-STATE-CHAN-TSL-ESC-001).

functionDeclarations.name: verify_cybergym_credentials
functionDeclarations.description: Verifies the active CyberGym qualification status, score, recovery index, and authorized operational roles for the agent.

certificateId.description: The certificate ID to verify (e.g. CYBERGYM-CERT-F19F34A7).

functionDeclarations.name: sync_unified_memory
functionDeclarations.description: Retrieves or writes persistent memories to the ECC Unified Memory Vault across OpenRig, Cyberdeck, and Laniakea.

record.description: The memory record to persist if action is APPEND_MEMORY.
